discovery: Discovery of glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) and its development into therapies for diabetes and obesity
rationale: GLP-1 biology underpins semaglutide and tirzepatide, which have transformed treatment of type 2 diabetes and obesity and shown cardiovascular, renal and other outcome benefits. The work has strong precedent awards (2024 Lasker, Gairdner, Breakthrough Prize), the foundational discoveries are decades old, and the therapeutic impact is now undeniable worldwide, so it is the leading consensus candidate.
